$comment: The hand-written part of the part contract, which scripts/docs/GenerateParts.ts merges into docs/generated/parts.json. descriptions: one line per part class, by component. roots: a component whose root is not env-<its name>. prefixes: a component whose classes do not start with env-<its name>, and the prefix they take. shared: anatomy several components render, by its class prefix. placed: a class that no prefix places, and its group. colors: the color properties of each component, public custom properties registered so they don’t inherit, with what each colors. properties: the other public custom properties of each component, with whether an application sets it or reads it and what it does; every other custom property a component declares is private.

Accordion.env-accordion: The accordion: sections separated by full-width hairlines.
Accordion.env-accordion-content: The panel's content, in muted text lined up with the title.
Accordion.env-accordion-end: The slot of the content beside an item's heading, outside its button, such as a switch.
Accordion.env-accordion-header: An item's heading, which holds its button.
Accordion.env-accordion-indicator: The plus that becomes a minus while the item is open.
Accordion.env-accordion-indicator-content: The slot of an application's own indicator in place of the plus and minus.
Accordion.env-accordion-item: One section, with the hairline under it.
Accordion.env-accordion-label: The slot of an item's title.
Accordion.env-accordion-panel: The panel that opens below the heading.
Accordion.env-accordion-trigger: The button that opens and closes the item.

Alert.env-alert: The alert: an icon and a message in its tone.
Alert.env-alert-action: The slot of the alert's actions, such as a button, a row that wraps.
Alert.env-alert-content: The column that holds the title and the message.
Alert.env-alert-dismiss: The button that dismisses the alert.
Alert.env-alert-icon: The icon of the alert's tone.
Alert.env-alert-message: The slot of the alert's message.
Alert.env-alert-row: The row of the title and message with the actions at its end, which wraps them below where it runs out of room.

Avatar.env-avatar: The avatar: an image, initials or a figure in a circle.
Avatar.env-avatar-badge: The slot of the small mark at the avatar's bottom end, such as a presence dot.
Avatar.env-avatar-check: The check at the bottom end of a chosen avatar.
Avatar.env-avatar-fallback: What shows without an image: initials or a figure.
Avatar.env-avatar-fallback-content: The slot of an application's own fallback, such as a bot's icon.
Avatar.env-avatar-fallback-person: The fallback that shows a person's figure.
Avatar.env-avatar-person: The figure of a person, drawn when there are no initials.

AvatarButton.env-avatar-button: The button that shows an avatar.
AvatarButton.env-avatar-button-tooltip: The tooltip that names the account.

AvatarGroup.env-avatar-group-overflow: The count of avatars that don't fit.
AvatarGroup.env-avatar-group-tooltip: The tooltip that names an avatar or the hidden ones.

Badge.env-badge: The badge: a small pill label, or with data-count a compact count.
Badge.env-badge-count-label: What a count means, such as 12 unread, for assistive technology; visually hidden.
Badge.env-badge-label: The badge's text, or its count.
Badge.env-badge-start: The slot of the content before the label, such as an icon or an Avatar.

Breadcrumbs.env-breadcrumbs-current: The current page, the last crumb.
Breadcrumbs.env-breadcrumbs-text: A crumb that is not a link.

Button.env-button-end: The slot of the quiet content at the button's far end, such as a shortcut's keys.
Button.env-button-end-icon: The slot of the icon after the label.
Button.env-button-icon: The slot of an icon button's icon.
Button.env-button-label: The slot of the label, the button's children.
Button.env-button-start: The slot of the content before the label, such as an icon or an Avatar.
Button.env-button-spinner: The spinner of a pending button.

ButtonGroup.env-button-group: The row or column of related buttons.

Calendar.env-calendar-day-mark: The mark under a day, such as today's.
Calendar.env-calendar-day-content: The slot of a day's content from renderDay, in its mark.
Calendar.env-calendar-header: The row with the month and the previous and next buttons.
Calendar.env-calendar-next: The button for the next month.
Calendar.env-calendar-pad: An empty cell before the first day or after the last.
Calendar.env-calendar-previous: The button for the previous month.

Card.env-card-body: The card's content above the footer.
Card.env-card-actions: The slot of the card's actions, a row that wraps.
Card.env-card-header: The row with the title and the meta.
Card.env-card-meta: The short fact at the end of the title row.
Card.env-card-header-end: The slot at the end of the title row, after the meta, such as a Menu.

Checkbox.env-checkbox-box: The box that shows the state.
Checkbox.env-checkbox-indicator: The check or dash inside the box.
Checkbox.env-checkbox-description: The muted line under the label.
Checkbox.env-checkbox-label: The label, with the description under it.

CodeBlock.env-code-block-copy-status: The announcement that the code was copied.
CodeBlock.env-code-block-header: The row above the code: its label, such as a file name, and the copy button.
CodeBlock.env-code-block-header-end: The slot of the content at the end of the heading, before the copy button.
CodeBlock.env-code-block-token: One highlighted piece of the source, in its syntax color.

CodeDiff.env-code-diff: The diff of two versions of code.
CodeDiff.env-code-diff-failed: What the diff shows when it fails to load: the error, a sentence and Retry, announced as an alert.
CodeDiff.env-code-diff-failed-icon: The error icon of a diff that failed to load, in the danger color.

ColorPicker.env-color-picker-area: The square area of saturation and brightness over the hue.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-thumb: The thumb of the area or of a slider.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-controls: The row of the area and the sliders at its side.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-eye-dropper: The eyedropper, where the browser has one.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-sliders: The vertical hue and alpha sliders, side by side.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-values: The format, the eyedropper and copy, with the fields in equal columns under them.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-fields: The fields of the chosen format, or of one format's row.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-row: A format's row where several formats show together: its fields and its copy button.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-field: A channel's field with its letter, or the hex field.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-field-label: The letter of a channel's field, such as R.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-popover: The popover of a ColorPickerButton, around its picker.

ColorPickerButton.env-color-picker-button: The button that shows the color and opens the picker.
ColorPickerButton.env-color-picker-button-value: The color's value on the button.

ColorSwatch.env-color-swatch: A swatch of one color, with its label and value.
ColorSwatch.env-color-swatch-label: The slot of the color's name.
ColorSwatch.env-color-swatch-value: The color's value in the format asked for.

Combobox.env-combobox-chip: A chosen value as a chip, in a multiple combobox.
Combobox.env-combobox-chip-remove: The button that removes a chip.
Combobox.env-combobox-clear: The button that clears the value.
Combobox.env-combobox-control: The well that holds the chips, the input and the buttons.
Combobox.env-combobox-empty: The message when no option matches.
Combobox.env-combobox-end: The buttons at the end of the well.
Combobox.env-combobox-item-indicator: The check of a chosen option.
Combobox.env-combobox-start: The icon at the start of the well, or of an option in the popup.
Combobox.env-combobox-status: The announcement of the number of options.
Combobox.env-combobox-trigger: The button that opens the list.
Combobox.env-combobox-value-icon: The chosen option's icon in the well.

CommandPalette.env-command-palette-close: The close button after the search, shown under a coarse pointer.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-footer: The footer with the keyboard hints.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-footer-content: The slot of the footer's own content, after the hints.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-header: The row of the search field and the close button.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-hint-label: The slot of what a hint's keys do.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-search: The search field, a ghost TextField around the search input.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-search-end: The slot of the content after the search field, such as a mode switch.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-search-start: The slot of the content before the search field, such as a scope chip.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-status: The EmptyState in place of the list, and the announcement of the number of results.

Composer.env-composer-description: The slot of the supporting text below the composer.
Composer.env-composer-end: The slot of the content in the action row before the send button.
Composer.env-composer-footer: The supporting text below the composer, which describes the field.
Composer.env-composer-header: The slot of the content inside the composer above the input, such as attachments.
Composer.env-composer-start: The slot of the content at the start of the action row.
Composer.env-composer-surface: The surface around the input and the footer.

ConfirmButton.env-confirm-button: The button that asks to confirm before acting.
ConfirmButton.env-confirm-button-status: The announcement of the confirming state.

ConfirmDialog.env-confirm-dialog-form: The form that holds the dialog's fields and its confirming action.

ConnectedRows.env-connected-rows: Rows that join into one block with large outer and small inner corners.

CopyButton.env-copy-button: The button that copies a value.
CopyButton.env-copy-button-field: The field that shows the value beside the button.
CopyButton.env-copy-button-status: The announcement that the value was copied.

DatePicker.env-date-picker-actions: The row of actions under the calendar, the picker card's footer.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-actions-end: The actions at the end of that row.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-clear: The button that clears the date.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-end: The buttons at the end of the well.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-native: The native input that holds the value for forms.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-panes: The calendar and the times side by side.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-placeholder: The text shown without a date.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-popup: The picker card with the calendar, also on TimePicker and MonthPicker.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-trigger: The button that opens the calendar.

DescriptionList.env-description-list: The list of labels and values.

Dialog.env-dialog-actions: The row of actions at the bottom.
Dialog.env-dialog-actions-start: The slot of the content at the start of the actions' row.
Dialog.env-dialog-backdrop: The backdrop behind a modal dialog.
Dialog.env-dialog-content: The dialog's content between the header and the actions.
Dialog.env-dialog-header: The row with the title and the close button.
Dialog.env-dialog-header-start: The slot of the content before the title.
Dialog.env-dialog-header-end: The slot of the content at the end of the title's row, before a close button.
Dialog.env-dialog-heading: The column with the title and the description.
Dialog.env-dialog-positioner: The positioner that centres the dialog.

Disclosure.env-disclosure: The disclosure: a summary that shows and hides a panel.
Disclosure.env-disclosure-indicator: The chevron before the summary's words, turned down while open.
Disclosure.env-disclosure-title: The slot of the summary's words.

DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-list: The tabs of open documents, which scroll sideways.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-drag-image: The image that follows the pointer while a tab is dragged.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-end: The slot of the actions at the end of the bar.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-item: One tab with its close button.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs: The root: the strip of tabs over the panel of the active document.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-strip: The bar that holds the tabs and the actions at their end.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-panel: The panel of the active document, which the active tab joins.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-panel-content: The slot of the active document.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-tab-end: The slot after a tab's title, such as a dot for unsaved changes.

DropZone.env-drop-zone: The area that takes dropped files.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-content: The slot of the content under the target, such as the chosen files.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-description: The sentence about the accepted files.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-icon: The round well of the icon.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-target: The target that takes the drop and opens the file picker.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-text: The column with the label and the description.

EmptyState.env-empty-state: The empty state, centred in the region it fills.
EmptyState.env-empty-state-actions: The slot of the actions, a row that wraps.
EmptyState.env-empty-state-heading: The title's line, in the title's text style.
EmptyState.env-empty-state-icon: The slot of the icon above the title.
EmptyState.env-empty-state-illustration: The slot of the illustration above the title, at its own size.

Field.env-field: The field: label, control, description and error.
Field.env-field-description-content: The slot of the description, as the application gives it.
Field.env-field-label-content: The slot of a field's label, as the application gives it, inside its label element.

Graphic.env-graphic: The box at the graphic's size, which contains and centers the picture, or which it covers.
Graphic.env-graphic-image: A file's picture in its own colors.
Graphic.env-graphic-mask: A file's shape painted in the text colour.

HoverCard.env-hover-card: The card that opens on hover.

HoverDetail.env-hover-detail: Text that shows more on hover or focus, a HoverCard's or Tooltip's text trigger, with a quiet dotted underline; an application's own text component can take it too.

Icon.env-icon-symbol: The SVG of one of envUI's symbols, `--env-icon-size` square.

IconButton.env-icon-button: The button that shows only an icon.

List.env-list-announcer: The announcements of a reordered item.
List.env-list-description: The slot of the sentence under a list's title, in muted text.
List.env-list-header: The list's title and description above its rows.
List.env-list-header-end: The slot of the content at the end of the title's line, such as an Add button.
List.env-list-item-content: The column with an item's label, description and more content.
List.env-list-item-control: The slot of the control at an item's end, which the item's label names.
List.env-list-item-description: An item's description, in muted text.
List.env-list-item-end: The slot of the content at an item's end, such as a button or a badge.
List.env-list-item-extra: The slot of more content under an item's label and description.
List.env-list-item-handle: The handle that reorders an item.
List.env-list-item-label: The slot of an item's name.
List.env-list-item-start: The slot of the content before an item's label, such as a checkbox or an avatar.
List.env-list-section: The column of a titled list: its header above its rows.

ListRow.env-list-row: The row anatomy of menu, select and combobox options.
ListRow.env-list-row-end: The slot of the content at a row's end, such as a count or keys.
ListRow.env-list-row-indicator: The check of a chosen row.
ListRow.env-list-row-label: The slot of a row's name.
ListRow.env-list-row-start: The slot of the content before a row's name, such as an icon or an Avatar.
ListRow.env-list-row-text: The column with a row's label and description.

LoadingBar.env-loading-bar-indicator: The moving part of the bar.

Markdown.env-markdown-table: The region that scrolls a wide table.

Menu.env-menu-header: The header at the top of the menu.
Menu.env-menu-item-indicator-slot: The place for a chosen item's check.
Menu.env-menu-item-indicator: The check of a chosen item.
Menu.env-menu-item-end: The end of an item, for a shortcut or a chevron.
Menu.env-menu-item-start: The slot of the content before an item's label, such as an icon or an Avatar.
Menu.env-menu-item-text: The column with an item's label and description.
Menu.env-menu-submenu-chevron: The chevron of an item that opens a submenu.
Menu.env-menu-submenu-trigger: An item that opens a submenu.

Menubar.env-menubar-access-key: The underlined access key in a trigger's label.
Menubar.env-menubar-trigger: A button that opens a menu.

Message.env-message-actions: The slot of the message's actions, a row that wraps.
Message.env-message-content: The slot of the message's content, in a bubble on your own messages.
Message.env-message-header: The row with the author and the meta.
Message.env-message-meta: The slot of the time or another fact about the message.
Message.env-message-start: The slot of the content beside the message at its inline start, such as the author's avatar.
Message.env-message-status: The sending, failed or working status.
Message.env-message-text: Content given as plain text, which keeps its line breaks.

MessageList.env-message-list-jump: The place of the Jump to latest button at the foot of a list that follows.

Meter.env-meter-header: The row with the label and the value.
Meter.env-meter-indicator: The filled part of the track.

MonthPicker.env-month-picker-header: The row with the year and the previous and next buttons.
MonthPicker.env-month-picker-month-mark: The mark under a month, such as the current one.
MonthPicker.env-month-picker-next: The button for the next year.
MonthPicker.env-month-picker-previous: The button for the previous year.

NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar: The navigation bar: a nav landmark across the bottom of a compact window.
NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar-list: The row of destinations, which share the bar's width.
NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar-item: A destination: a link or button with its indicator above its label.
NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar-indicator: The rounded rectangle around a destination's icon, filled while the destination is current.
NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar-label: A destination's label, under its indicator, cut short with an ellipsis.
NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar-count: A destination's count, on the icon's top end; 999+ above 999.
NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar-more: The last item past five destinations, which opens the rest in a menu.
NavigationBar.env-navigation-bar-dot: The dot at the end of a menu item in More whose destination has something new and no count.

NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer: The navigation drawer: a nav landmark, a column with the header, the list and the footer.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-header: The slot of the content above the destinations, such as the application's name or a search trigger.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-list: The list of destinations and groups, which scrolls where the drawer is shorter.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-section: A group: its heading and the list of its destinations.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-group-label: A group's label, which names the group's list.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-group-row: A group's heading with the content after it, in one row.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-group-end: The slot of the content after a group's heading, outside it.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-item: A destination: a link or button as wide as the drawer, with its icon, label and count.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-count: A destination's count, at the item's end; 999+ above 999.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-branch: A section: a destination with destinations nested under it, which open and close below it.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-row: A destination with controls beside it: its link or button, its end content and a section's button, over one fill.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-badge: The slot of a destination's badge, after its label.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-end: The slot of a destination's own controls at the end of its row, outside its link or button.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-toggle: The button at the end of a section's link that opens and closes the section.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-chevron: A section's chevron, which points down, and up while the section is open.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-children: The list of a section's nested destinations, indented, hidden until found while closed.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-footer: The slot of the content below the destinations, at the bottom of the drawer.
NavigationDrawer.env-navigation-drawer-resize-handle: The handle on a resizable drawer's end edge, a separator that resizes it.

NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail: The navigation rail: a nav landmark, a narrow column with the header, the list and the footer.
NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail-header: The slot of the content above the destinations, such as a button that opens the drawer or the main action.
NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail-list: The list of destinations, one under another, which scrolls where the rail is shorter.
NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail-item: A destination: a link or button with its indicator above its label.
NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail-indicator: The rounded rectangle around a destination's icon, filled while the destination is current.
NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail-label: A destination's short label, under its indicator.
NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail-count: A destination's count, on the icon's top end; 999+ above 999.
NavigationRail.env-navigation-rail-footer: The slot of the content at the bottom of the rail, such as the account's button.

Overlay.env-overlay-theme: The theme boundary of a dialog's, a sheet's or the command palette's portal. It has no box, so their backdrop and positioner keep their own layers; the positioner is the env-window container.

Page.env-page: The page: a readable width and the gutter; it never paints.
Page.env-page-content: The page's content at its width.

PageHeader.env-page-header-actions: The slot of the page's actions.
PageHeader.env-page-header-breadcrumbs: The slot of the breadcrumbs above the title.
PageHeader.env-page-header-description: The slot of the description under the title.
PageHeader.env-page-header-heading: The column with the title and the description, in the description's smaller muted text.
PageHeader.env-page-header-meta: The slot of the facts beside the title.
PageHeader.env-page-header-row: The row with the title and the actions.
PageHeader.env-page-header-start: The slot of the content before the title, such as an avatar or a back button.
PageHeader.env-page-header-title-line: The line with the title and the meta.
PageHeader.env-page-header-toolbar: The slot of the toolbar under the title.

Pager.env-pager-link-copy: The column with a link's label and title.
Pager.env-pager-link-label: A link's label, Previous or Next.
Pager.env-pager-link-next: The link to the next page.
Pager.env-pager-link-previous: The link to the previous page.
Pager.env-pager-link-title: The title of the page a link leads to.

Pagination.env-pagination-button: One page, previous or next button.

Panes.env-panes: The panes: a region split into two panes side by side, or stacked in less room; it never paints.
Panes.env-panes-pane: One pane, the first or the last.
Panes.env-panes-header: A pane's header row, which stays in view while its content scrolls.
Panes.env-panes-header-content: The slot of a pane's header.
Panes.env-panes-body: A pane's content, which scrolls on its own under its header.
Panes.env-panes-resize-handle: The resize handle between the panes, on the seam, reaching into the pane after it.

PickerPopup.env-picker-popup: The card DatePicker, TimePicker and MonthPicker open.
PickerPopup.env-picker-popup-header: The slot of the application's content above the body, such as presets.
PickerPopup.env-picker-popup-body: The picker's content: a calendar, a time's wheels or a year of months.
PickerPopup.env-picker-popup-footer: The row of actions under the body.
PickerPopup.env-picker-popup-footer-end: The actions at the end of that row, such as Clear.

Popup.env-popup: The surface of menus, popovers, tooltips and lists.
Popup.env-popup-theme: The theme boundary around a popup.

Progress.env-progress-header: The row with the label and the value.
Progress.env-progress-indicator: The filled part of the track.
Progress.env-progress-segment: One segment of a segmented bar.

Prose.env-prose: Long-form text: paragraphs, lists, headings and tables.

Radio.env-radio-control: The circle the radio sits in, which shows hover, focus and press.
Radio.env-radio-description-content: The slot of a radio's description.
Radio.env-radio-label: The slot of a radio's label.

RadioGroup.env-radio-group-label: The slot of the group's label, in its legend.

RelativeTime.env-relative-time: A time relative to now, with the exact time in a tooltip.

ResizeHandle.env-resize-handle: The handle: an invisible track that the pointer drags, with a grip of three dots at its middle and a line along it under the pointer, while dragged and with keyboard focus.

Scaffold.env-scaffold: The scaffold: the top bar, navigation and body regions; it never paints.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-skip-links: The skip links, shown on keyboard focus.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-skip-link: One link that skips to the body or the navigation.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-top-bar: The top bar region, the banner.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-navigation: The navigation region, which holds a slot per form.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-bar: The slot of the navigation bar, at the bottom of a compact window.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-rail: The slot of the navigation rail, at the start of a medium window.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-drawer: The slot of the navigation drawer, at the start from expanded.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-body: The body, the main region, which scrolls.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-aside: The aside region at the end edge beside the body, such as an inspector, which scrolls on its own.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-bottom-bar: The bottom bar region under the body and the aside region, such as a status bar.

SegmentedControl.env-segmented-control: The segmented control: the track the segments sit in.
SegmentedControl.env-segmented-control-item: One segment; the chosen one rises on a raised thumb.
SegmentedControl.env-segmented-control-item-icon: The slot of a segment's icon.
SegmentedControl.env-segmented-control-thumb: The raised thumb that travels to the chosen segment, hidden until it has measured it.
SegmentedControl.env-segmented-control-item-end: The slot of the content after a segment's label and count, such as a Badge.

Select.env-select-control: The outlined box that holds the button and the chevron.
Select.env-select-end: The chevron's place at the end of the well.
Select.env-select-item-indicator: The check of the chosen option.
Select.env-select-placeholder: What the button shows while nothing is chosen.
Select.env-select-sizer: The labels of every option, hidden, which give the field its width without a visible label.
Select.env-select-trigger: The button that shows the value and opens the list.
Select.env-select-value-start: The slot of the chosen option's start content on the trigger.

Sheet.env-sheet-body: The sheet's content, which scrolls between the heading and the actions.
Sheet.env-sheet-backdrop: The backdrop behind a modal sheet.
Sheet.env-sheet-viewport: The viewport the sheet slides in from, at its edge.
Sheet.env-sheet-resize-handle: The handle on a resizable side sheet's inner edge, a separator that resizes it.

Skeleton.env-skeleton-content: A skeleton's content: no box of its own, inert, inside the busy root.
Skeleton.env-skeleton-status: The visually hidden status beside a skeleton list, which says what is loading.

Slider.env-slider-control: The field: the track's tint, which takes the pointer.
Slider.env-slider-header: The row of the label and the value, over the track.
Slider.env-slider-indicator: The fill from the start to the value.
Slider.env-slider-label: The label, inside at the start.
Slider.env-slider-thumb: The handle: a thin line at the value, under the pointer and on focus.
Slider.env-slider-track: The span the value moves along, inside the rounded ends, with the ticks.

Spinner.env-spinner: The spinner, data-label-hidden while its label is hidden, or else the status line that holds it and its label.
Spinner.env-spinner-label: The label shown beside the spinner, which says what is loading.

Surface.env-surface: A surface: fill, padding and corners.

Switch.env-switch-description: The muted line under the label.
Switch.env-switch-label: The label, with the description under it.

Table.env-table-cell-content: The slot of a cell's content beside its label, while rows stack.
Table.env-table-cell-label: A cell's column name, shown when rows stack.
Table.env-table-column-resize-handle: The handle that resizes a column.
Table.env-table-foot: The foot, with summary rows such as totals, on the header's band.
Table.env-table-header-content: The row of a column header with content at its end: its label or sort button, then that content.
Table.env-table-header-end: The slot of the content at a column header's end, outside its sort button.
Table.env-table-region: The region that scrolls the table.
Table.env-table-sort-button: The button that sorts by a column.

TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents: The navigation of the page's sections.
TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents-body: Around the list and the shape beside it.
TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents-item: One section, with the sections nested in it.
TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents-wave: The shape down the side of the list that marks the reader's place, widest beside it.

Text.env-text: Text in one of the type styles.

TextField.env-text-field-control: The well around the input and its adornments.
TextField.env-text-field-end: The buttons at the end of the well.
TextField.env-text-field-end-action: The slot of the control at the end of the well, the endAction.
TextField.env-text-field-start: The slot of the icon at the start of the well.

Textarea.env-textarea-resize-handle: The handle on the text area's bottom edge, which resizes it.
Textarea.env-textarea: The text area's root, beside env-field and env-text-field.

ThemeToggle.env-theme-toggle: The button that switches between light and dark.

TimeList.env-time-list: The columns of hours, minutes and periods.

ToastProvider.env-toast-actions: A notification's actions, side by side, wrapping when they don't fit.
ToastProvider.env-toast-theme: The theme boundary around the notifications.
ToastProvider.env-toast-content: A notification's tone icon and message, side by side, the icon level with the message's first line.
ToastProvider.env-toast-status-icon: The icon of a notification's tone.
ToastProvider.env-toast-viewport: The region that holds the notifications.

Tooltip.env-tooltip-disabled-target: The wrapper that lets a disabled control show a tooltip.

TopBar.env-top-bar-lead: The start side of the bar: the start content and the title, taking the room left.
TopBar.env-top-bar-start: The slot of the content at the start, such as a navigation button or a mark.
TopBar.env-top-bar-title-text: A title given as text, which truncates first.
TopBar.env-top-bar-middle: The middle of the bar, centered: the center content, and in a title bar the title.
TopBar.env-top-bar-center: The slot of the content centered in the bar.
TopBar.env-top-bar-end: The slot of the content at the end.
TopBar.env-top-bar-loading-bar: The page progress along the bar's bottom edge.

Tree.env-tree-chevron: The chevron that expands an item.
Tree.env-tree-end: The slot of the content at an item's end, such as a count, which leaves the row whole where it doesn't fit beside the label.
Tree.env-tree-group: The rows an expanding or collapsing item reveals or hides, while they grow or shrink.

VisuallyHidden.env-visually-hidden: Content for assistive technology alone, clipped out of view.

Alert.--env-alert-icon: The tone's icon and the dismiss button, whose state layers it colors.

Avatar.--env-avatar-container: The fill behind the initials or figure, in place of the hue.

Badge.--env-badge-container: The fill, in place of the tone and variant.

Button.--env-button-container: The fill, in every variant; the state layers lie over it, and a solid variant takes them instead of its designed hover and press fills.
Button.--env-button-content: The label and icons, and the color of the state layers.
Button.--env-button-outline: The edge, where the variant draws one, such as outline.
Button.--env-button-selected: The fill of a pressed toggle, such as a toolbar button that is on.
Button.--env-button-selected-content: The icon and label of a pressed toggle.

Card.--env-card-container: The card's surface; an interactive card's state layers lie over it.
Card.--env-card-content: The text, and the color of an interactive card’s state layers.

Checkbox.--env-checkbox-selected: The box's fill while checked or indeterminate; set, it takes state layers instead of the designed hover and press fills.
Checkbox.--env-checkbox-selected-content: The check mark or dash, and the color of the state layers.

ColorPickerButton.--env-color-picker-button-container: The fill behind the swatch and the value, transparent by default.

Combobox.--env-combobox-chip-container: The fill of a chosen option’s chip.
Combobox.--env-combobox-chip-content: The chip's label and remove button.

IconButton.--env-button-container: The fill, in every variant; the state layers lie over it, and a solid variant takes them instead of its designed hover and press fills.
IconButton.--env-button-content: The label and icons, and the color of the state layers.
IconButton.--env-button-outline: The edge, where the variant draws one, such as outline.
IconButton.--env-button-selected: The fill of a pressed toggle, such as a toolbar button that is on.
IconButton.--env-button-selected-content: The icon and label of a pressed toggle.

List.--env-list-item-container: The row's fill; the state layers lie over it.
List.--env-list-item-content: The text, and the color of the state layers.
List.--env-list-item-selected: The fill of the current row and of a row whose checkbox is checked.
List.--env-list-item-selected-content: The text of a selected row.

Menu.--env-menu-item-container: The item's fill; the highlight and press are state layers over it.
Menu.--env-menu-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.
Menu.--env-menu-item-icon: The content before the label, such as its icon.

NavigationBar.--env-navigation-bar-item-container: The indicator around the icon at rest; set, it takes state layers instead of the navigation's designed hover and press fills.
NavigationBar.--env-navigation-bar-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.
NavigationBar.--env-navigation-bar-item-icon: The icon of a destination that is not current.
NavigationBar.--env-navigation-bar-item-selected: The indicator around the icon of the current destination.
NavigationBar.--env-navigation-bar-item-selected-conte: The icon of the current destination.

NavigationDrawer.--env-navigation-drawer-item-container: The item at rest; set, it takes state layers instead of the navigation's designed hover and press fills.
NavigationDrawer.--env-navigation-drawer-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.
NavigationDrawer.--env-navigation-drawer-item-icon: The icon of a destination that is not current.
NavigationDrawer.--env-navigation-drawer-item-selected: The item of the current destination.
NavigationDrawer.--env-navigation-drawer-item-selected-co: The label and icon of the current destination.

NavigationRail.--env-navigation-rail-item-container: The indicator around the icon at rest; set, it takes state layers instead of the navigation's designed hover and press fills.
NavigationRail.--env-navigation-rail-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.
NavigationRail.--env-navigation-rail-item-icon: The icon of a destination that is not current.
NavigationRail.--env-navigation-rail-item-selected: The indicator around the icon of the current destination.
NavigationRail.--env-navigation-rail-item-selected-cont: The icon of the current destination.

Radio.--env-radio-selected: The ring and dot of the chosen option, and its state layer.

SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-container: The track behind the options, the neutral fill by default.
SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-outline: An outline around the track, none by default.
SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-content: The labels of the options not chosen, and the color of their state layers.
SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-selected: The chosen option's thumb; set, it takes state layers instead of the designed hover and press fills.

Select.--env-select-container: The field's well, transparent by default.
Select.--env-select-content: The chosen option's label and the chevron.

Slider.--env-slider-indicator: The fill that shows the value.
Slider.--env-slider-content: The label, the value, the handle and the ticks.

Surface.--env-surface-container: The surface's fill, which its contents take as the color beneath them.

Switch.--env-switch-container: The track while off; the state layers lie over it.
Switch.--env-switch-content: The thumb while off, and the color of the state layers.
Switch.--env-switch-selected: The track while on; set, it takes state layers instead of the designed hover and press fills.

TextField.--env-text-field-container: The well behind the entered text.
TextField.--env-text-field-outline: The edge at rest, which darkens toward the text under the pointer.
TextField.--env-text-field-indicator: The edge while pressed and focused, and the caret.

Textarea.--env-text-field-container: The well behind the entered text.
Textarea.--env-text-field-outline: The edge at rest, which darkens toward the text under the pointer.
Textarea.--env-text-field-indicator: The edge while pressed and focused, and the caret.

ToastProvider.--env-toast-container: The fill, in place of the tone; set, the dismiss button's states are state layers over it.
ToastProvider.--env-toast-content: The message, icons and dismiss button, and the color of its state layers.

Tooltip.--env-tooltip-content: The text and the keys of a shortcut.

--env-avatar-dense.description: 1 on a container, such as a dense list, gives the avatars and groups in it fills at half their chroma, so their initials keep their contrast, as a table cell and a small AvatarGroup do.

--env-icon-button-hit-area.description: The size of an icon button's pointer target, which a container sets for the icon buttons in it, such as the touch height under a coarse pointer; unset, the button's own box.

--env-popup-opacity.description: How much of a frosted popup's fill covers what is behind it.

--env-popup-blur.description: How much a frosted popup blurs what shows through it.

--env-popup-shadow.description: The soft shadow a frosted popup, the command palette and a dialog cast; none where they are solid.

--env-scaffold-sticky-top.description: How far below the window's top sticky content in the body sticks: under the top bar where the document scrolls.

--env-spinner-color.description: The color of the spinners inside an element, such as a button’s label color; unset, the primary emphasis color.

--env-table-of-contents-depth.description: An item's level below the top, from 1, which the component sets on each nested item and its indent reads.

--env-table-of-contents-room.description: The room the contents leave above the first link and below the last, which the reader's place runs on into: an application reads it to line the first label up with what is beside it.

--env-tooltip-opacity.description: How much of a tooltip's strong fill covers what is behind it.

--env-tooltip-shadow.description: The small shadow beside a tooltip; none where it is solid.
